summary: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to provide civil liability protection for individuals who use or attempt to use an automated external defibrillator (AED) during a perceived medical emergency, as well as for property owners and AED owners, unless harm is caused by gross negligence or willful misconduct.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to encourage the deployment and use of Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) by providing uniform civil liability protections. This directly relates to emergency medical care and public health infrastructure, making it a healthcare-focused bill. By reducing liability concerns, it seeks to improve access to life-saving devices, which leans towards expanding public health resources.
